helanshan.credit: 贺兰山岩画太阳神.jpg — 霧島聖 · CC BY-SA 4.0
helanshan.description: Lying in a vertical rock-wall about 20 meters above the ground, this god face rock painting enjoys a highest geological location ever found among all rock paintings in Helankou (refers to the Helan Gorge). It has rigorous modeling and overlooks the gorge. The wide-open round eyes brimming with radiating vigor overlook the gorge. Just as the sun shines upon all alike and the gods bless all living creatures, it is addressed as “God of Sun”, a typical representative of nature and god worship. The radiative light of numbers from its head is arranged as 24, 12, 6, respectively. Some scholars believe that it is probably related with China’s 24 solar terms or solar calendar.

poyang.title: A Siberian Crane Family at Poyang Lake on December 2023.tif
poyang.author: A Dim Light Chaser
poyang.credit: A Siberian Crane Family at Poyang Lake on December 2023.tif — A Dim Light Chaser · CC BY 4.0
poyang.description: This image was captured during the bird watching season at Poyang Lake at the end of 2023.  The most impressive bird I had watched is the Siberian Crane, also known as Snow Crane.  They have snowy white feathers all over their bodies, with only their feet and faces in red. Their noses are positioned in the mid-rear section of a deep brown bill.  Their eyes are round, light yellow to white, with black-brown pupils from my observation in this image.  They forage and perform other actions in family groups, usually consisting of two parents and one juvenile (with feathers in orange-yellow), forming a trio of three white cranes.  I once witnessed a meeting between one family group and another; after a simple interaction, each group went their separate ways with their respective juveniles.  This picture was captured during this event with my full-frame mirrorless camera and a 400 mm telephoto lens.
